location.title: Location access
location.always: ROLT can always use your location, so it keeps recording with the screen off. To narrow it, change it in your phone settings.
location.whileUsing: ROLT can use your location only while the app is open. To keep recording with the screen off, choose “Always” in your phone settings.
location.off: ROLT can't access your location, so recording and nearby routes don't work. You can allow it in your phone settings.

photos.title: Photo access
photos.all: ROLT can access all your photos, so adding pictures to rides and your profile is quick. To narrow it, change it in your phone settings.
photos.limited: ROLT can only access the photos you chose. To add pictures from your library more easily, you can widen the access.
photos.off: ROLT can't access your photos. To add pictures to rides and your profile, allow it in your phone settings.

stopped.q: Why did my ride stop halfway?
stopped.a:
Recording doesn't end when GPS or the internet drops. When the GPS signal gets weak, recording pauses by itself and continues when the signal is back; that stretch isn't added to distance or time.

If your phone turns off or the app is closed, the ride stays on your device. When you open the app again, “Unfinished ride found” lets you continue or finish it.

To keep recording with the screen off, set location access to “Always”.

gpsDrift.a:
Tall buildings, tunnels, narrow valleys and dense trees weaken the GPS signal. When accuracy gets worse than 50 metres, ROLT leaves that part out of the recording so the track doesn't jump.

For better results, make sure “Precise location” is on in your phone's location settings.

tooShort.a: Rides shorter than 1 km can't be saved; finishing one shows “Ride too short”. Keep riding and finish later, or delete the ride.

offline.a: Yes. Your ride is saved on your device first; no connection is needed. It syncs once you're online.

shareRide.q: How do I share my route?
shareRide.a:
After saving a ride, use “Share now” to share it on WhatsApp, Instagram or with a link. To share later, use “Share” on the ride detail.

To publish a route for everyone to discover, use “Suggest a route” in Discover.

rideRoute.q: How do I ride a route?
rideRoute.a: Tap “Start riding this route” on the route detail. On the prepare screen you can add stops, turn on voice guidance and start. Save your ride when you arrive.

saveRoute.q: How do I save routes I like?
saveRoute.a: Tap the bookmark on a route card or on the route detail. Saved routes are in Profile > Saved.

visibility.a:
While saving a ride, pick Everyone, My followers or Only me in “Visibility”. After saving, change it from “…” > Visibility on the ride detail.

Set the default for new rides in Settings > Ride visibility.

hideEndpoints.q: How do I hide where I live or work?
hideEndpoints.a: In Settings > Start/finish points you can hide the first and last part of your rides on maps and choose how much. Distance, time and speed don't change.

password.q: How do I change my password?
password.a: Go to Settings > Account details > Change password and set a new one with your current password. If you sign in with Apple or Google, your password is managed there.

background.q: Why does recording stop with the screen off?
background.a: To keep recording with the screen off, ROLT needs to always use your location. Open phone settings from Settings > Location and choose “Always”.

noNotifications.q: I'm not getting notifications. What should I do?
noNotifications.a: First make sure ROLT notifications are on in your phone settings. Then choose which ones you want in Settings > Notifications.

photoAccess.q: Why can't I see all my photos?
photoAccess.a: With “Limited access”, ROLT only sees the photos you chose. Open phone settings from Settings > Photos to widen the access.

privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.intro: ROLT processes some data to record your rides and suggest routes to you. This text explains which data we collect, why, and how long we keep it.

sections.title: 1. Data we collect
paragraphs: Location: We collect your GPS track only while you record a ride. When recording stops, location tracking stops too.
Account: Your email address and the user ID from Apple or Google. We never see your password.

sections.title: 2. How we use data
paragraphs: We use your ride data to show you distance, time and speed summaries, and to rank route suggestions by your area.

sections.title: 3. Sharing
paragraphs: By default your rides are visible only to you. You can change visibility in Settings › Ride visibility.

terms.title: Terms of Use
terms.intro: By using ROLT you accept the terms below. If they change, we let you know in the app.

sections.title: 1. Scope of the service
paragraphs: ROLT offers ride recording, route discovery and ride data tracking. The service is provided as is; uninterrupted operation isn't guaranteed.

sections.title: 2. Riding safety
paragraphs: ROLT is not a navigation device. Don't interact with your phone while riding; start recording and put the phone away. Following traffic rules is entirely your responsibility.

sections.title: 3. Your content
paragraphs: You own the routes, notes and images you share. You give us a limited licence to show them in ROLT.
